an10.16:1.1: dasa ime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an10.16:1.3: tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, paccekabuddho, ubhatobhāga vimutto, paññāvimutto, kāyasakkhī, diṭṭhippatto, saddhāvimutto, dhammānusārī, saddhānusārī, gotrabhū.
an10.16:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave dasa puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā, dakkhiṇeyyā, añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
